_comment: Curated definition of the public team-share site. Data only — the generator is tools/build_site.py. Two ways in: (1) list a surface here plainly, in which case it must be provably public-safe — the --public build genericizes product-surface/company names via SANITISE and fails if any BLOCKLIST term survives; or (2) list it with "protected": true, which skips the sanitiser and publishes the page encrypted, or omits it entirely when SITE_PASSPHRASE is absent. Explainers do belong here once they pass the guard. What stays out is anything carrying client material or a surface neither route can make safe. A one-off prototype with no durable audience is better left as a private Claude Artifact than added here.

site.title: Orbit Design Brain — Team Tools
site.tagline: The living tools for turning a rough idea into a testable concept — capture it, and watch the vault that grounds it stay healthy.

tools.title: Concept Brief Intake
tools.blurb: Capture a concept — the problem, the one user and moment, the testable bet, the outcome. Outputs a brief to hand to the design team. Everything stays in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.title: Vault Health
tools.blurb: The auto-updating health of the design brain: what's inside it, how complete it is, which checks pass, and where to find any of it in the repo. Refreshes daily.
tools.protected_note: Carries product-surface names, the owner's name, and repo file paths. Skips SANITISE and is encrypted at publish time with SITE_PASSPHRASE; if that secret is absent the page is omitted entirely rather than published in the clear.

tools.title: Run the intake pilot with your team
tools.blurb: The step-by-step playbook for testing the concept-intake loop: set up the two Claude Projects, pick testers, run the loop, and capture what you learn.

tools.title: Concept to prototype — the flow
tools.blurb: How an idea travels through the vault: coached into a brief, gated against the contract, explored as a throwaway concept, then ported on-system.

tools.title: About the Orbit Vault
tools.blurb: What the design brain is, what's inside it, how it's governed and shared, and the benchmark evidence that it works. Generated from the vault itself.
